meta.name: Chainsmoker Cat
meta.description:
Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones' concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

Rated TV-MA · Ended · First aired 3 Jul 2026 · Japan · Language: Japanese · 24 min
Studio: Bibury Animation Studios, Kodansha, NBCUniversal Entertainment Japan · Network: TOKYO MX

Complete series. On your server: S1 12/12

On your server — Audio: Japanese, Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: I'm Yani Neko, Nya
videos.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay rent and spends what little she has on cigarettes — until an urgent text from her sister Imoko sparks a far greater crisis.

videos.title: Meet My Juniors, Nya
videos.overview: Yani wants to continue her carefree life, but she receives a job offer as financial pressure builds. Will she commit to this opportunity or her freedom?

videos.title: I'm More Straight Than Funny, Nya
videos.overview: After another clash with her landlord, Yani agrees to tend his garden to cover her rent. It seems like a perfect fix — until she faces his cabbage patch.

videos.title: Freaks All Around Me, Nya
videos.overview: Yani lands a job assisting Saori Tatsuro, a risque manga artist. After Yani mistakenly burns her manuscript, an unexpected police visit follows.

videos.title: We're Off to a Secret Place, Nya
videos.overview: Despite her sister's attempts to take away her cigarettes, Yani refuses to quit. At the same time, Imoko navigates a youthful romance.

videos.title: Summer Starts and Ends Here, Nya
videos.overview: Yani's fellow tenant Aruko disappears during a drinking party while three new assistants arrive at Tatsuro's workplace as her deadline looms closer.

videos.title: I Was Born to Parents Too, Nya
videos.overview: Yani takes a cleaning job at a shady underground facility. Meanwhile, her landlord welcomes a new houseguest, quickly followed by an unexpected mishap.

videos.title: Even We Run Around in December, Nya
videos.overview: Yani expects a lonely birthday, unaware that Imoko is planning a surprise party for her. Elsewhere, Yani's landlord becomes trapped in a foul time loop.

videos.title: My Little Sis Is Popular, Nya
videos.overview: Yani's peculiar toilet habits spark chaos around her while Imoko receives a gift from a secret admirer who turns out to be anything but ordinary.

videos.title: I'm Gonnya Enjoy the Outing Too, Nya
videos.overview: Yani's neighbors Yakuneko and Hameneko head to a mystical waterfall — but Hameneko's selfishness drives Yakuneko to hatch a wild revenge plan.

videos.title: We're in Kyoto, Nya
videos.overview: Yani and her flatmates set off on a Kyoto and Nara getaway — but her antics lead to an encounter with the "King of Deer," a creature of ancient wisdom.

videos.title: I'm Gonnya Smoke Even in the Last Episode, Nya
videos.overview: As her issues push the other residents to the edge, a worn-out Yani lashes out at her landlord — triggering the biggest brawl in the building's history.
